title: Rolling Attestation Renewals: subscription-based evidence continuity for long-term enterprise contracts
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Background: Enterprise customers with multi-year contracts require recurring evidence and attestations for security questionnaires (SIG/CAIQ) as part of renewal and audit cycles. Currently customers either request fresh attestation bundles ad hoc (high manual effort) or accept stale evidence, leading to repeated legal friction and stalled procurements.

Problem statement: We lack a scalable mechanism to keep attestations and evidence fresh over long contract durations without forcing manual rework from security/solutions teams. This increases sales friction, creates hidden support costs, and reduces the likelihood of expansion for accounts under strict compliance regimes.

Goal: Design and pilot a "Rolling Attestation Renewals" product that automatically issues updated evidence bundles on a subscription cadence (quarterly / semi-annual) tied to a customer contract. Include optional auto-dispatch to a customer's security portal or SFTP, and an opt-in pricing uplift.

Success metrics: (1) reduce time-to-first-attestation-response for renewals by 60% for pilot accounts; (2) reduce manual E2E support hours per renewal by 70%; (3) convert 25% of pilot accounts to paid rolling attestation subscription within 60 days; (4) NPS lift from security contacts +8 points for pilot cohort.

Scope (MVP): - Evidence tokens generator: canonicalized export of CAIQ answers, sampled logs retention statements, KMS/HSM proof pointers, and signed metadata with expiry. - Renewal scheduler: per-contract cadence, configurable by PM/customer success. - Delivery options: secure S3/SFTP push, link in support portal, or API webhook. - Minimal UI in Console: toggle subscription, set cadence, view last three bundles. - Pricing experiment hooks: pricing_tiers field and coupon mechanics for pilot.

Non-goals: Full questionnaire re-answering automation, auto-remediation of security gaps, on-prem attestation signing for this pilot.
acceptance_criteria: Pilot customers (n=3) can enable rolling attestation on their contract and receive signed evidence bundles on the configured cadence.
Bundles include CAIQ answer snapshot, retention and encryption metadata, and a signed JSON manifest with TTL/expiry in ISO-8601.
Console displays subscription status and last-dispatched timestamp; support team can manually trigger a dispatch.
Pricing experiment telemetry is generated for each enable action and billing events tied to subscription activation are emitted to billing system.
Legal signs off on wording for auto-renewal and data sharing in the attestation manifest and the pilot contract addendum.
